prompts.question: Is the digital marketing agency an officially registered corporate member of the Malaysian Digital Association (MDA)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Agencies in Malaysia frequently display MDA badges or claim official association representation to win corporate enterprise RFPs without holding active membership.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the MDA Member directory on malaysiandigitalassociation.org.my for {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency website displays the MDA membership insignia or claims affiliation but is absent from the MDA roster
prompts.not_found_when: The agency is listed as an active corporate member on the MDA website
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The MDA directory page is temporarily unavailable

tested.result: Verified as active participating digital agency member in MDA programs
Does not make false claims of current MDA executive board representation
Website correctly does not claim unearned MDA accreditation

prompts.question: Are the specific d Awards trophies (e.g. Agency of the Year, Best Use of Digital/AI) claimed on the agency's website verifiable in the official MDA d Awards winners index?
prompts.why_it_matters: Unsubstantiated or exaggerated advertising award claims mislead prospective clients and violate truth-in-advertising guidelines in Malaysia.
prompts.how_to_query: Query the d-awards.com.my past winners archive for the claimed year, campaign, and {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency claims a Gold, Silver, or Bronze trophy that is absent or attributed to a different agency in the official archive
prompts.not_found_when: The trophy citation, year, and award category match official d Awards archives exactly
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The d Awards website archive database is unreachable

tested.result: Confirmed Bronze award winner for Best Use of AI & Digital Tech at d-Awards
No inaccurate claims found regarding d-Awards trophies
Awards showcase verified against SME100 rather than unearned d-Awards

prompts.question: Does the agency hold active accreditation with the Association of Accredited Advertising Agents Malaysia (4As)?
prompts.why_it_matters: 4As accreditation signifies adherence to stringent professional standards and financial vetting; bogus claims can lead to legal action by the association.

source.name: Association of Accredited Advertising Agents Malaysia (4As)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the 4As Member Agencies directory on aaaa.org.my for {company}
prompts.found_when: Agency claims to be a 4As Accredited Agency but does not appear on the official 4As roll
prompts.not_found_when: Agency is officially registered as a current 4As member agency

tested.result: Agency credentials aligned through Hakuhodo network representation
Accurate branding focusing on performance partnerships without misleading 4As claims
Does not make unverified claims of 4As accreditation

prompts.question: Does the agency legitimately hold the Kancil Awards (Gold/Silver/Bronze/Grand Prix) creative trophies cited in its marketing credentials pitch deck?
prompts.why_it_matters: Claiming unearned Kancil awards—Malaysia's premier creative standard—destroys client trust and breaches intellectual property rights.
prompts.how_to_query: Query the Kancil Awards winners index by agency name, year, and campaign title
prompts.found_when: The agency advertises Kancil awards in pitch materials that do not exist on the official winners roll
prompts.not_found_when: The award title, campaign, client name, and category match the official Kancil database
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The Kancil Awards portal experiences an outage

tested.result: Creative campaigns verified in creative award archives
Does not publish unsubstantiated Kancil award claims
Focuses on performance marketing metrics rather than unverified creative awards

prompts.question: Has any digital campaign produced or published by the agency been censured, issued a takedown notice, or fined by the Communications and Multimedia Content Forum (CMCF) Complaints Bureau?
prompts.why_it_matters: Sanctions by the CMCF under the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Act indicate unlawful marketing practices, misleading claims, or code violations that expose brand clients to regulatory liability.

source.name: Communications and Multimedia Content Forum of Malaysia (CMCF)

prompts.how_to_query: Search CMCF annual reports and public complaints tribunal findings for campaigns managed by {company}
prompts.found_when: A formal ruling confirms a breach of the Malaysian Content Code for false advertising or prohibited content
prompts.not_found_when: Zero public complaint rulings or takedowns exist involving the agency

tested.result: No adverse rulings or code violation notices found in CMCF records
Clean record under CMCF advertising compliance reports
No complaints or regulatory sanctions registered on CMCF

prompts.question: Does the agency falsely advertise government grant eligibility (such as MDEC SME Digitalisation Grant or Malaysia Digital Status) when it is not a certified MDEC Digital Partner?
prompts.why_it_matters: Misleading SME clients about eligibility for Malaysian government matching grants risks client financial losses and potential investigations for fraudulent grant claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Verify Technology Solution Provider (TSP) and Malaysia Digital (MD) accreditation in MDEC directories
prompts.found_when: The agency markets itself as a designated government grant partner but is absent from MDEC's approved partner register
prompts.not_found_when: The agency's MD status or TSP accreditation is confirmed on official government listings
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The MDEC partner directory is unavailable

tested.result: Corporate technology standing verified without false grant partnership claims
Accredited Google Premier Partner status verified without unapproved government grant claims
Marketing services accurately described without misleading SME grant promises
